original:
Lemma 5.

Let $G$ be a graph, $e\in E(G),$ and $P(e)$ and $S(e)$ be the parallel and series class of $e$ with $|P(e)|=p$ and $|S(e)|=s.$ Then:

(a) 

if $P(e)$ is a multiple bridge, then

 $T_{G}(2,0)=2T_{G/P(e)}(2,0)\quad\text{and}\quad T_{G}(1,1)=pT_{G/P(e)}(1,1),$

(b) 

if $P(e)$ is not a multiple bridge, then

 $T_{G}(2,0)=T_{G-P(e)}(2,0)+T_{G/P(e)}(2,0)\quad\text{and}$ 

 $T_{G}(1,1)=T_{G-P(e)}(1,1)+pT_{G/P(e)}(1,1)\qquad$
